core_gradient_evidence: Gated BF16 gradient and input/geometry/weight gradients were bitwise equal before the routed check. Gate derivative changed only by FP32 reduction reassociation; BF16 router rounding amplified the small change.
decision: Retain exact original Torch gate row reduction. New producer stores the original FP32 dot-product terms alongside BF16 gated gradients.
